audit.whatIsWrong: win[6] and phases[6].side gave the 2+ items row to Gnar at 8/10, while whys[6], spikes[3].text and late all say Kled out-scales and 'the 2+ items window tilts to him'. Level 6 was also given to Gnar at 8/10 while whys[4] says a Mini window with Rage down lets Kled delete you.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Kled at 2+ items and Skill at Level 6; the prose already agreed with the packet and only the sides were wrong. On a 50.65% win rate an 8/10 late-game row is indefensible.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flipped to Kled at 4/10 with phases[6].why rewritten; Level 6 flipped to Skill at 5/10. Levels 1-3 left with Gnar and Levels 4-5 / First item left Skill — those match both the packet and the text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kled's re-engage was described as happening 'on his own timer' with no cooldown, and Bear Trap was tracked with no number either.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110 — at rank 3 that is a 110-second re-engage, which is what makes the late-game reset loop real and also what makes a spent ult a genuine window. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1, which is short enough that stepping up 'when his Q is down' has to be timed, not assumed.
audit.corrected: 110s added to whys[6], spikes[3].text, late and phases[6].why; the 11s Bear Trap cooldown added to early.
sources: enemyKit Bear Trap on a Rope cd 11/10/9/8/7

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent from both layers: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants a shield, Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset, and both champions carry displacement. Separately, spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1] tell the reader Kled's dismount damage shreds them.
audit.why: Riot's Skaarl text says Kled deals LESS damage to champions while dismounted — the dismounted form is the weak state and the remount is the threat, so the page had the danger inverted. Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s shield absorbs exactly the burst half of a Wallop-into-GNAR! commit and was never mentioned. Violent Tendencies gives massive attack speed for four attacks with a bigger fourth, so his burst opens on an auto wind-up, not a spell cast. And GNAR!'s knockup against Bear Trap's yank is a straight displacement race: whoever lands first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: Shield added to spikes[3].text, late and phases[6].why; Violent Tendencies named as the damage source in early and spikes[2].text; the displacement race added to mid; the dismount claim corrected in late and wants.foe[1].
sources: enemyKit Skaarl / Chaaaaaaaarge!!! / Violent Tendencies text

audit.whatIsWrong: The ability names are misspelled throughout: 'Beartrap on a Rope' / 'Beartrap-on-a-Rope' for Bear Trap on a Rope, and 'Chaaaaaarge!!!' (six a's) for Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (eight).
audit.why: Riot's names are Bear Trap on a Rope and Chaaaaaaaarge!!!; a reader searching either spelling finds nothing.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every field I was already rewriting. The full layer still carries 'Beartrap on a Rope' in roughly fifteen boilerplate strings (loading, focus.text, breakdown.*, dosFull, report) — flagged in notes rather than rewritten, since those are template fills, not analysis.

edits.before: Kled wants to brawl at level 1-2, but that's exactly where Mini Gnar's range punishes him - auto, throw a Boomerang for the slow, and at 2 your Hyper third-hit speed plus the Boomerang catch-refund lets you stack chip he can't trade back while Skaarl can only walk at you. The trap to dodge is his Beartrap-on-a-Rope (Q): land or not, it's a skillshot, and if it hooks you it pulls you onto him and Skaarl's autos start ticking. Weave behind minions, sidestep the grab, and only step up to commit a Hyper proc when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Kled wants to brawl at level 1-2, but that's exactly where Mini Gnar's range punishes him - auto, throw a Boomerang for the slow, and at 2 your Hyper third-hit speed plus the Boomerang catch-refund lets you stack chip he can't trade back while Skaarl can only walk at you. The trap to dodge is Bear Trap on a Rope (Q), an 11-second skillshot at rank 1: if it hooks and holds, it yanks you onto him and Violent Tendencies' four fast autos start ticking. Weave behind minions, sidestep the grab, and step up for a Hyper proc only while his Q is down.

edits.before: This is the volatile stretch and it lives and dies on your Rage bar. With Mega up you win outright - Wallop stuns his Q pull and his charge, and if you can shove him into a wall, GNAR! is a kill. Stuck in Mini with Rage on cooldown is the nightmare: a landed Beartrap drags squishy you in, Skaarl charges, and you melt before Hop gets you out. At 6 you gain no new button - Gnar's whole power spike is just whether Mega is ready - so bait his Q with a Mini step, then transform into the all-in rather than letting him pick the timing.
edits.after: This is the volatile stretch and it lives and dies on your Rage bar. With Mega up you win outright - Wallop stuns his Q pull and his charge, and if you shove him into a wall, GNAR! is a kill. You both carry displacement, so whoever lands it first owns the trade: his yank or your knockup. Stuck in Mini with Rage down is the nightmare - a landed Bear Trap drags you in and you melt before Hop gets you out. At 6 you gain no new button, so bait his Q with a Mini step, then transform into the all-in.

edits.before: The lane stays close on the win rate, but Kled is the scaler here and the 2+ items window tilts to him. His remount loop and Chaaaaaarge!!! re-engage let him reset fights faster than your Rage-gated burst can close them, and once he can dive back in repeatedly your kiting plateaus. Your out is teamfights - GNAR! into a wall is one of the best engage-peel ults in the game, so stop trying to solo-duel a remounted Kled and turn your form pressure into a 5v5 wombo before items fully decide it.
edits.after: The lane stays close on the win rate, but Kled is the scaler here and the 2+ items window tilts to him. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! returns every 110 seconds with a shield on it, so he re-engages on his own timer and that shield swallows the burst half of your combo. Note his dismounted form deals reduced damage to champions - what you deny is the remount, not the dismount. Your out is teamfights: GNAR! into a wall is elite engage-peel, so stop solo-duelling a remounted Kled and play the 5v5.

edits.before: Catch the Mini window so Skaarl's remount autos and his dismount damage shred you before Mega comes online
edits.after: Catch the Mini window so Violent Tendencies' four autos and a fresh Skaarl remount shred you before Mega is online

notes: Ability names were misspelled everywhere: 'Beartrap on a Rope' should be Bear Trap on a Rope, and 'Chaaaaaarge!!!' should be Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (eight a's). I fixed both in the content fields I rewrote, but the full layer still carries the wrong spelling in loading, focus.text, breakdown.mid/cooldowns/spikes/feeding/difficulty, tradeGood's siblings, dosFull[0].t/.d, dontsFull, and report[1]/[5]/[9]/[10]/[12]/[13] — those are template boilerplate and a global find-replace is safer than fifteen separate before/after edits. focus.text is 'Kled Beartrap on a Rope', so the tracked-cooldown chip on the live page shows the wrong name. Also: report[8].t and breakdown.late both prescribe anti-heal as core, but nothing in Kled's kit heals — Skaarl's courage restore is a resource refill, not lifesteal — so the anti-heal advice looks like template bleed. I did not edit it because I cannot verify Kled's item-based healing from the kits alone.
